item.title: Etikoppaka toys of Anakapalli get GI tag
item.description: The Geographical Indications Registry in Chennai has granted the GI tag to the lacquerware toys of Etikoppaka in Anakapalli district.

Andhra Pradesh to set up AI hub in Visakhapatnam with ₹87,000 crore investment
item.description: The State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB) chaired by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu cleared a ₹87,000 crore data centre and AI hub, the largest FDI in the State.
